defs.def: to leave your job, school, etc. 离开（工作职位、学校等）；离任；离校

ex.s: Why did John quit his part-time job?
8.Why does Cathy want to quit her job？
Why would David quit his job?
Susan had quit her well-paid job and _________ as a volunteer in the neighborhood when I visited her last year.
ex.t: 去年我去看苏珊时，她已经辞去了高薪工作，____作为一名志愿者在社区做事。

ex.s: I finally quit delivering newspapers and didn’t see Mrs Stanley for several years.
ex.t: 我终于不再送报纸了，此后好几年没见过斯坦利太太。

ex.s: In 405, he quit the service of the court for good, expressing his unhappiness in the now famous line that he would not “bow like a servant in return for five dou of grain”.
ex.t: 公元405年，他永远辞去了官职，用那句现在已是家喻户晓的名言表达了他的不满：他不会"为五斗米折腰"。

ex.s: Jan Tchamani, an English teacher in Birmingham, UK, suddenly developed a serious illness and had to quit her job.
ex.t: 简·查马尼，英国伯明翰的一名英语教师，突然患上了严重疾病，不得不辞去工作。

defs.def: to stop doing sth 停止；戒掉

ex.s: Quitting is in fact necessary for growth.
ex.t: 放弃其实对成长而言是必要的。

ex.s: Why is quitting necessary for growth?
ex.t: 为什么放弃对成长是必要的？

ex.s: (Excerpts from "Don't quit" by Edgar Albert Guest) (picture 1) J.D.
ex.t: （摘选自埃德加·阿尔伯特·格斯特的《不要放弃》）（图1） J.D.

ex.s: Obviously, I was unhappy, but I won’t quit.
ex.t: 显然，我不开心，但我不会放弃。

ex.s: He just can’t seem to quit.

defs.def: to leave the place where you live 离开，迁出，搬离（住处）
to close a computer program or application 关闭，退出（计算机程序等）
